name: holodori Gacha
precaution:
■Important Notes
・Spend Blue Diamonds, Red Diamonds, Gacha Tickets and other items to earn Members.
・Red Diamonds are spent first.
・Only some Members appear. Please check the Drop Rates.
・Drop rates of Members in this Gacha vary by Member.
・Members when you first obtain them are Lv1.
・Members appearing in this Gacha may have duplicates.
・Obtaining a duplicate of a Member will convert them into the corresponding member’s Bloom Pts.
・When earning specific Members, you will obtain Live Outfits and Park Outfits at the same time.
・The contents of this Gacha may change without warning.

▼Gacha Mechanics
(1) Each spin of the Gacha is based on the drop rates.
(2) When spinning multiple times, each spin is based on the same drop rates, regardless of the results of previous spins.
・Once Per Day Gacha only accepts Blue Diamonds.
・Once Per Day Gacha resets daily.
・10-Pulls Gacha guarantees at least one ★4 Member or higher. ★4 Member or higher guaranteed drop rates conform to ★4 or higher Guaranteed Slot List.
・Drop rates other than ★4 Guaranteed Slot List (10-Pull) conform to [Standard Pool].
・Drop Rates vary depending on Members.
・The visible Drop Rate is cut off at the fifth decimal number, so the total may not equal 100%.
・An instable connection to the server may result in display issues with Gacha, or skipped entirely. However, Gacha results will be unaffected.
・Previous results of Gacha can be viewed in [Gacha Log].

▼Gacha Pts
■How To Earn
・You can earn 1 Gacha Pt per Gacha pull.
・Gacha Pts earned from this gacha will not be added to or carried over from other gacha draws.

■How To Use
・You can earn any Member from the list by spending Gacha Pts at the Gacha Pt Exchange.
・For information on members that can be exchanged for with Gacha Pts, please check the "Gacha Pt Exchange" menu.
・Earned Gacha Pts can only be exchanged for eligble members during Gacha event period.
・For information Gacha event period, please check the in-game announcement.

■Important Notes
・Gacha Pts not used during the Gacha event period are converted into Holo Stickers after the event has concluded and sent to your Gift Box. Use them in [Shop] → [Holosticker Exchange].
・The duration and contents of Gacha Pt Exchange may change without warning.

▼Holosticker
You can exchange them for various items by going to [Shop] → [Holosticker Exchange].

▽How To Obtain Holosticker & Amount
・If Gacha Pt exchange period expires, 1Pt = 1 Sticker
・Fully Bloomed ★3 Member = 1 Sticker
・Fully Bloomed ★4 Member = 20 Stickers
* This also includes ★3 & ★4 Members that have the required Bloom Pts to fully Bloom.

▼Special Holosticker
You can exchange them for various items by going to [Shop] → [Special Holosticker Exchange].

▽How To Obtain Special Holosticker & Amount
・★5 Member = 30 Stickers
・Fully Bloomed ★5 Member = 100 Stickers
* If the ★5 Member you obtain has already been fully Bloomed, you can earn a total of 130 Stickers.
* This also applies when you obtain a ★5 Member who have the required Bloom Pts to fully Bloom.
